92	def plot_reliability_diagram(confidences, accuracies, n_bins=10,
93	                              label='', color='#0072B2',
94	                              title='Reliability Diagram',
95	                              outpath='reliability.pdf'):
96	    """
97	    confidences, accuracies: 各样本的 confidence 和 binary correct (0/1)
98	    """
99	    bin_edges = np.linspace(0, 1, n_bins + 1)
100	    bin_accs, bin_confs, bin_counts = [], [], []
101	
102	    for i in range(n_bins):
103	        lo, hi = bin_edges[i], bin_edges[i+1]
104	        mask = (confidences >= lo) & (confidences < hi)
105	        if mask.sum() > 0:
106	            bin_accs.append(accuracies[mask].mean())
107	            bin_confs.append(confidences[mask].mean())
108	            bin_counts.append(mask.sum())
109	        else:
110	            bin_accs.append(float('nan'))
111	            bin_confs.append((lo + hi) / 2)
112	            bin_counts.append(0)
113	
114	    bin_accs = np.array(bin_accs)
115	    bin_confs = np.array(bin_confs)
116	
117	    fig, (ax_main, ax_hist) = plt.subplots(
118	        2, 1, figsize=(4, 4.5), gridspec_kw={'height_ratios': [3, 1]},
119	        sharex=True
120	    )
121	
122	    # 主图：gaps
123	    ax_main.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_accs, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
124	                color=color, alpha=0.7, label='Accuracy', zorder=2)
125	    ax_main.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_confs - bin_accs, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
126	                bottom=bin_accs, color='red', alpha=0.3, label='Gap', zorder=2)
127	    ax_main.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], 'k--', linewidth=1, zorder=3, label='Perfect')
128	    ax_main.set_xlim(0, 1); ax_main.set_ylim(0, 1)
129	    ax_main.set_ylabel('Accuracy')
130	    ax_main.set_title(title)
131	    ax_main.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=9)
132	    ax_main.grid(True, alpha=0.3, zorder=1)
133	
134	    # ECE annotation

136	                    np.abs(bin_accs - bin_confs))
137	    ax_main.text(0.98, 0.02, f'ECE={ece:.3f}', transform=ax_main.transAxes,
138	                 ha='right', va='bottom', fontsize=9,
139	                 bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', alpha=0.8))

**用途**：显示模型 confidence bin vs accuracy，对角线 = 完美校准。

```python
def plot_reliability_diagram(confidences, accuracies, n_bins=10,
                              label='', color='#0072B2',
                              title='Reliability Diagram',
                              outpath='reliability.pdf'):
    """
    confidences, accuracies: 各样本的 confidence 和 binary correct (0/1)
    """
    bin_edges = np.linspace(0, 1, n_bins + 1)
    bin_accs, bin_confs, bin_counts = [], [], []

    for i in range(n_bins):
        lo, hi = bin_edges[i], bin_edges[i+1]
        mask = (confidences >= lo) & (confidences < hi)
        if mask.sum() > 0:
            bin_accs.append(accuracies[mask].mean())
            bin_confs.append(confidences[mask].mean())
            bin_counts.append(mask.sum())
        else:
            bin_accs.append(float('nan'))
            bin_confs.append((lo + hi) / 2)
            bin_counts.append(0)

    bin_accs = np.array(bin_accs)
    bin_confs = np.array(bin_confs)

    fig, (ax_main, ax_hist) = plt.subplots(
        2, 1, figsize=(4, 4.5), gridspec_kw={'height_ratios': [3, 1]},
        sharex=True
    )

    # 主图：gaps
    ax_main.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_accs, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
                color=color, alpha=0.7, label='Accuracy', zorder=2)
    ax_main.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_confs - bin_accs, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
                bottom=bin_accs, color='red', alpha=0.3, label='Gap', zorder=2)
    ax_main.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], 'k--', linewidth=1, zorder=3, label='Perfect')
    ax_main.set_xlim(0, 1); ax_main.set_ylim(0, 1)
    ax_main.set_ylabel('Accuracy')
    ax_main.set_title(title)
    ax_main.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=9)
    ax_main.grid(True, alpha=0.3, zorder=1)

    # ECE annotation
    ece = np.nansum(np.array(bin_counts) / sum(bin_counts) *
                    np.abs(bin_accs - bin_confs))
    ax_main.text(0.98, 0.02, f'ECE={ece:.3f}', transform=ax_main.transAxes,
                 ha='right', va='bottom', fontsize=9,
                 bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', facecolor='white', alpha=0.8))

    # 直方图（样本密度）
    ax_hist.bar(bin_edges[:-1], bin_counts, width=1/n_bins, align='edge',
                color=color, alpha=0.5)
    ax_hist.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=9)
    ax_hist.set_xlabel('Confidence')

    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig(outpath)
    plt.close()
    print(f'Saved: {outpath}')
```

```python
def plot_ece_heatmap(delta_ece_matrix, methods, datasets,
                     title='ΔECE Heatmap (vs FP16)',
                     outpath='ece_heatmap.pdf'):
    """
    delta_ece_matrix: shape (n_methods, n_datasets), 正=ECE 恶化, 负=改善
    """
    import matplotlib.colors as mcolors

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(len(datasets) * 1.2, len(methods) * 0.8 + 1))

    # 发散色图（中心=0, 红=恶化, 蓝=改善）
    vmax = np.nanmax(np.abs(delta_ece_matrix))
    norm = mcolors.TwoSlopeNorm(vmin=-vmax, vcenter=0, vmax=vmax)
    cmap = plt.cm.RdBu_r

    im = ax.imshow(delta_ece_matrix, cmap=cmap, norm=norm, aspect='auto')

    # 数值标注
    for i in range(len(methods)):
        for j in range(len(datasets)):
            val = delta_ece_matrix[i, j]
            if not np.isnan(val):
                color = 'white' if abs(val) > vmax * 0.6 else 'black'
                sign = '+' if val > 0 else ''
                ax.text(j, i, f'{sign}{val:.1%}', ha='center', va='center',
                        fontsize=9, color=color, fontweight='bold')

    ax.set_yticks(range(len(methods)))
    ax.set_xticklabels(datasets, rotation=30, ha='right')
    ax.set_yticklabels(methods)
```

```python
def wilson_ci(p, n, z=1.96):
    if n == 0: return 0, 0
    denom = 1 + z**2 / n
    center = (p + z**2 / (2*n)) / denom
    half = z * np.sqrt((p*(1-p) + z**2/(4*n)) / n) / denom
    return max(0, center - half), min(1, center + half)

# 用法

            fmt='o', capsize=4, capthick=0.8, elinewidth=0.8,
            markeredgecolor='white', markeredgewidth=1.0)
```

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate Figure 1: Two-stage architecture diagram."""

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch
import os

out_dir = '/root/persuasion_turn_jailbreak_detect/paper/figures/'
os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 7,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
})

FW = 3.25
FH = 4.5
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(FW, FH))
ax.set_xlim(0, FW)
ax.set_ylim(FH, 0)  # y=0 at top
ax.axis('off')

CX = FW / 2

# ── Color palette ──
C = dict(
    bb='#2C7BB6', bb_e='#1A5276',
    g1='#7F8C8D', g1_bg='#F2F3F4',
    g2='#D4AC0D', g2_bg='#FEF9E7',
    g3='#1ABC9C', g3_bg='#E8F6F3', g3_hi='#148F77',
    s2='#7D3C98', s2_bg='#F4ECF7',
    out='#C0392B', out_bg='#FDEDEC',
    dk='#2C3E50', md='#555555', lt='#888888',
    arr='#555555',
)

def rbox(cx, cy, w, h, fc='white', ec='#333', lw=0.7):
    b = FancyBboxPatch((cx - w/2, cy - h/2), w, h,
                        boxstyle='round,pad=0.025',
                        fc=fc, ec=ec, lw=lw, zorder=2)
    ax.add_patch(b)

def txt(x, y, s, fs=7, fw='normal', c=C['dk'], **kw):
    return ax.text(x, y, s, ha='center', va='center',
                   fontsize=fs, fontweight=fw, color=c, zorder=3, **kw)

def arr_fn(x1, y1, x2, y2, c=C['arr'], lw=0.6):
    ax.annotate('', xy=(x2, y2), xytext=(x1, y1),
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=c, lw=lw,
                                shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0), zorder=1)

def ln(x1, y1, x2, y2, c=C['arr'], lw=0.6, ls='-'):
    ax.plot([x1, x2], [y1, y2], c=c, lw=lw, ls=ls, zorder=1, clip_on=False)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
# STAGE 1
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════

txt(CX, 0.12, 'Stage 1: DeBERTa Variant Training', fs=8, fw='bold')

# Backbone box
y0 = 0.38
rbox(CX, y0, 2.6, 0.28, fc=C['bb'], ec=C['bb_e'], lw=1.0)
txt(CX, y0, 'DeBERTa-v3-base (pretrained)', fs=6.5, fw='bold', c='white')

# Fork from backbone
y1 = y0 + 0.24
ln(CX, y0 + 0.14, CX, y1)
g1x, g2x, g3x = 0.58, CX, FW - 0.58
ln(g1x, y1, g3x, y1)
y2 = y1 + 0.15
for gx in [g1x, g2x, g3x]:
    arr_fn(gx, y1, gx, y2)

# Layout params
H = 0.18   # header height
I = 0.22   # item height
P = 0.07   # padding
W = 0.90   # group width

def group_hdr(gx, y_top, label, sep_c, txt_c):
    txt(gx, y_top + P + H/2, label, fs=5.5, fw='bold', c=txt_c)
    ln(gx - W/2 + 0.06, y_top + P + H, gx + W/2 - 0.06, y_top + P + H,
       c=sep_c, lw=0.3)

def var_item(gx, y, name, desc, hi=False):
    fc = C['g3_hi'] if hi else C['dk']
    fw = 'bold' if hi else 'normal'
    txt(gx, y + 0.05, name, fs=6, fw=fw, c=fc)
    txt(gx, y + 0.15, desc, fs=4.5, c=C['lt'], fontstyle='italic')

# ── Group 1: No Adaptation ──
n1 = 1
g1h = H + n1 * I + P * 2
rbox(g1x, y2 + g1h/2, W, g1h, fc=C['g1_bg'], ec=C['g1'], lw=0.5)
group_hdr(g1x, y2, 'No Adaptation', '#D5D8DC', C['g1'])
yv = y2 + P + H + P
var_item(g1x, yv, 'vanilla', 'no fine-tuning')

# ── Group 2: MLM Adaptation ──
n2 = 2
g2h = H + n2 * I + P * 2
rbox(g2x, y2 + g2h/2, W, g2h, fc=C['g2_bg'], ec=C['g2'], lw=0.5)
group_hdr(g2x, y2, 'MLM Adaptation', '#F9E79F', '#7D6608')
yv = y2 + P + H + P
for nm, ds in [('JB-MLM', 'jailbreak text'), ('wiki-MLM', 'Wikipedia text')]:
    var_item(g2x, yv, nm, ds)
    yv += I

# ── Group 3: Classification ──
n3 = 4
g3_extra = 0.32
g3h = H + n3 * I + P * 2 + g3_extra
rbox(g3x, y2 + g3h/2, W, g3h, fc=C['g3_bg'], ec=C['g3'], lw=0.5)
group_hdr(g3x, y2, 'Classification', '#A3E4D7', C['g3_hi'])
yv = y2 + P + H + P
for nm, ds, hi in [('topic', 'topic classif.', False),
                    ('scrambled', 'shuffled labels', False),
                    ('binary', 'presence/none', False),
                    ('9-class', 'full treatment', True)]:
    var_item(g3x, yv, nm, ds, hi=hi)
    yv += I
# Two-head detail
ln(g3x - W/2 + 0.06, yv, g3x + W/2 - 0.06, yv, c='#A3E4D7', lw=0.3)
txt(g3x, yv + 0.08, '2 heads:', fs=5, fw='bold', c=C['g3_hi'])
txt(g3x, yv + 0.18, 'persuasion (9)', fs=4.5, c=C['md'])
txt(g3x, yv + 0.27, 'intent (binary)', fs=4.5, c=C['md'])

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
# SEPARATOR: frozen [CLS] embeddings
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
yb1 = y2 + g1h
yb2 = y2 + g2h
yb3 = y2 + g3h
y_sep = max(yb1, yb2, yb3) + 0.18

for gx, yb in [(g1x, yb1), (g2x, yb2), (g3x, yb3)]:
    arr_fn(gx, yb, gx, y_sep, c=C['arr'], lw=0.5)

ln(0.1, y_sep, FW - 0.1, y_sep, c=C['arr'], lw=0.8, ls='--')
txt(CX, y_sep, 'frozen [CLS] embeddings', fs=5.5, c=C['md'],
    fontstyle='italic',
    bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.03', fc='white', ec='none', alpha=0.9))

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
# STAGE 2
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════
y_s2 = y_sep + 0.22
txt(CX, y_s2, 'Stage 2: Multi-turn Classifier', fs=8, fw='bold')
txt(CX, y_s2 + 0.14, '(K-prefix evaluation)', fs=5, c=C['md'], fontstyle='italic')

# Turn boxes
y_t = y_s2 + 0.40
tw, th = 0.48, 0.22
turns = [(-0.85, '[CLS]₁'), (-0.28, '[CLS]₂'), (0.28, '···'), (0.85, '[CLS]ₖ')]
for dx, label in turns:
    tx = CX + dx
    if '·' in label:
        txt(tx, y_t, label, fs=9, c=C['md'])
    else:
        rbox(tx, y_t, tw, th, fc='#EBF5FB', ec='#85C1E9', lw=0.4)
        txt(tx, y_t, label, fs=5.5)

# Arrow to BiGRU
y_bigru = y_t + th/2 + 0.22
arr_fn(CX, y_t + th/2, CX, y_bigru - 0.12)

# BiGRU box
rbox(CX, y_bigru, 2.2, 0.28, fc=C['s2_bg'], ec=C['s2'], lw=0.8)
txt(CX, y_bigru, 'BiGRU (h=256, L=2, drop=0.3)', fs=6, fw='bold', c=C['s2'])

# Arrow to output
y_out = y_bigru + 0.14 + 0.18
arr_fn(CX, y_bigru + 0.14, CX, y_out - 0.10)

# Output
rbox(CX, y_out, 1.5, 0.25, fc=C['out_bg'], ec=C['out'], lw=0.8)
txt(CX, y_out, 'Jailbreak / Benign', fs=6, fw='bold', c=C['out'])

# ── Save ──
pdf_path = out_dir + 'fig1_architecture.pdf'
png_path = out_dir + 'fig1_architecture.png'
plt.savefig(pdf_path)
plt.savefig(png_path)
plt.close()
print(f'Saved: {pdf_path}')
print(f'Saved: {png_path}')
